Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`). Try it: `uvx --from miseenplace-cli mep demo`.

`mep` now keeps itself up to date, and the README has a demo GIF.

## Highlights

- Once a day, in a background process that never delays your command, `mep` checks PyPI. If it knows how it was installed (`uv tool`, `pipx` or a virtual environment) it upgrades itself; the new version applies on the next run. Any other install gets one line on stderr, once a day.
- `mep update` checks and upgrades now.
- `mep skills --install DIR` copies the bundled skills and remembers the directory, so an upgrade refreshes them. `mep skills` still prints the path.
- Opt out with `MISEENPLACE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1` or `auto_update = false` in `config.toml`. It stays off in CI, without a terminal, and for `send`.
- README: demo GIF, sample output, a how-it-works diagram, status and roadmap, updates and uninstall.

## Try it

```bash
uv tool upgrade miseenplace-cli
mep update
```

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ankitkpandey1/miseenplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
